# KeyVault - Zero-Knowledge Password Security & Entropy Analyzer

> KeyVault is a high-assurance, client-side zero-knowledge password strength evaluator, offline entropy estimator, and credential vulnerability auditing workbench.

## Core Capabilities
- **Zero-Knowledge Architecture**: Password analysis, pattern matching, entropy estimation, and dictionary cross-referencing occur 100% locally in-browser or via an offline FastAPI microservice without plaintext transmission.
- **Multi-Vector Entropy Modeling**: Evaluates character pool dispersion, shannon entropy, repetitive patterns, sequential runs, keyboard walking, and l33t speak substitutions.
- **Hardware Brute-Force Crack Benchmarks**: Calculates realistic time-to-crack metrics across modern GPU clusters (RTX 4090, 8x A100), cloud distributed rigs, and quantum-adjacent dictionary attacks.
- **Offline Breach Auditing**: Checks compromised hash prefixes against local k-anonymity bloom filters and HaveIBeenPwned API paradigms without exposing credential hashes.
- **Cryptographic Password Generator**: Uses Web Crypto API (`window.crypto.getRandomValues`) for cryptographically secure pseudo-random token generation with customizable character pools and passphrases.

## Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons, Vite.
- **Backend / Microservice**: FastAPI, zxcvbn-python, Python 3.12.
- **Deployment**: Production SPA deployed to Vercel at https://pwsec-nyz.vercel.app/
